# Example plots for Stage 5 — Reporting

Illustrative output of one development run, embedded in
`docs/pipeline/05_reporting.md` to show what each plot looks like:

- Single-run plots (6) — from the `report/` of one 3-camera run on `bin_c0_r3`
- Cross-run aggregate plots (4) — from the `aggregate/plots/` of ten 6-camera
  repeats of the same bin

They illustrate the report *format*, not a benchmark result. Replacing them
with the output of any other run works as long as the file names stay
identical, since `05_reporting.md` references them by name.
